title: Concurrent Flame Spread Modeling using Flamelet Generated Manifolds in Microgravity with Comparison to BASS Experiments using Two-Color Tomography

sources.title: Concurrent Flame Spread Modeling using Flamelet Generated Manifolds in Microgravity with Comparison to BASS Experiments using Two-Color Tomography

key_findings: The UFGM approach accurately reproduced concurrent flame spread in microgravity, including the 'Goldilocks' flammability zone.
The predictive capabilities of the UFGM approach were assessed across both microgravity and normal-gravity conditions.
fields.earth_applications: This research provides predictive tools for screening new materials’ flammability limits, which can lead to the design of safer spacecrafts.
